scripts.deploy:a: vite build && node tools/stamp-build.mjs staging-a && fly deploy -c fly.staging.toml --ha=false
scripts.deploy:b: vite build && node tools/stamp-build.mjs staging-b && fly deploy -c fly.staging-b.toml --ha=false
scripts.which: for u in https://ygteev-backyard-staging.fly.dev https://ygteev-backyard-staging-b.fly.dev; do printf '%s  ' "$u"; curl -s $u | grep -o 'ygteev-build[^>]*' || echo '(no stamp)'; done
